resources.string: Paste a video link you own or are authorized to download, then track processing and files.
Paste an HTTPS video share link
Only process content you own or are explicitly authorized to download. DRM, authentication, paywalls, and platform access controls are not bypassed.
You can also share a link from another app to VideoFetch Pro.
Progress and status will appear here after you create an authorized task.
Files will appear here when an authorized task completes.
Sign-in and per-user API credentials are being integrated. The app will not ship with an administrator key.
The client shell is ready. Task submission will be enabled after sign-in and authorized provider integrations are available.
There is no usable text link in the clipboard.
This is a preference only. Actual quality depends on your account entitlement, the source video, and the versions the platform makes available.
You may paste a Cookie from your own account. It is encrypted and stored on this device only; it is not uploaded to the VideoFetch Pro server.
Cookie encrypted and saved on this device.
Could not save. Check the provider ID, hostname, and Cookie format.
Never share your Cookie. It is an account session credential. No provider adapters are enabled yet, so this saved Cookie will not be used for requests until a reviewed adapter is added.
Downloads are staged in the app-specific VideoFetch Pro folder on this device and can be opened from this screen.

Resolution is a ceiling filter. Frame rates (30/60/120 fps), HDR/SDR, codecs (AV1/VP9/H.264), and audio tracks will be listed separately once a provider adapter reports the actual formats; unavailable options will never be fabricated.
This platform does not have a parser integration yet, so video details are unavailable. No sign-in is required; supported platforms will work directly when integrated.
Could not parse this link. Check it and try again.
The parser did not return displayable video information.
Video information was returned, but no downloadable formats are available yet.
Could not start the download. Check whether this format is still available.
YouTube details are available. Its official API does not provide a video-file download URL; this app will not bypass platform access controls.
Niconico details are available. Download requires a valid provider watch session and media stream; this version does not invent an unverified download URL.
